events.context: Owner ratification of the two constitutional acts inside the v1.3.0 status-honesty amendment (PR #813, merged 2026-07-22), which the certified cross-model review flagged as needing explicit post-merge human ratification rather than silent adoption. (1) Deadline-voiding: the lapsed 2026-04-15 Message Integrity hard-reject deadline was voided 'until reissued' -- ratified; rationale: an unenforced deadline that nothing implements is a false claim, and the status-honesty table is the mechanism that prevents the next one. Reissue requires a new dated changelog entry plus a receiver-side verifier shipping in the same change. (2) Machine-emitter retroactive legalization: the Registered Machine Emitters table (Rule 1 amendment) retroactively legalized scripts/compliance_report.py as the compliance-reporter emitter (observer model, origin_repo = observed repo) -- ratified; rationale: ~110 instances of operating history predate the rule text, and schema-follows-reality is the repo's recorded doctrine (state/pdca/2026-05-01-evolution-schema-follows-reality.pdca.json). Ratified by owner directive in the 2026-07-23 session ('all these'); recorded by Claude Fable 5. Append-only discipline preserved: both acts amend status labels and registries, removing no sections.

effectiveness.proposition: The v1.3.0 honesty framework held for its first full cycle: v1.4.0 shipped with explicit status labels, an evidence-gate waiver recorded in the changelog, and a scope-bounded IMPLEMENTED row, demonstrating that the amendment is doing the work it was designed to do.
